title: PLAN — SDD-011: økonomien blir papir, fire rå dokumenter erstatter Franks notat

context.setupNotes:
## What this plan is

SDD-011 replaces `doc_konto` and `doc_papirer` (two `ØKONOMISK OVERSIKT` documents, both Frank's prose) with four raw primary papers: two bank statements, one electricity bill, one till receipt. The player derives the reading instead of being handed it.

The work has four seams, in this order: a pipe-row table grammar in the markup, a table renderer on the paper, three new paper kinds, then the case-content swap.

## Two-track split (SDD-011 §Verification, ruled by Terje 2026-08-11)

**Track V — this plan.** Pipe-row grammar, emitter shapes, the BBCode table form, bake determinism, and a manifest assertion that every anchored fact measures at least one UV rect.

**Track F — gate tickets, not plan tasks.** Terje reads the four baked PNGs cold. Task 7 preps that gate and files it. No plan task waits on Terje.

## Baseline state, verified 2026-08-11

1. `npm run gen:content:check` — green.
2. `npm run bake:docs:check` — green. Chromium launches in this environment and the PNGs are byte-deterministic, so the bake is an agent-reachable judge, not a Terje-only step.
3. `npm run lint` — **red before you start**, on three untracked files from other in-flight work: `prototypes/paper-reference/in-game-dokumenter.dc.html`, `prototypes/paper-reference/support.js`, `prototypes/script-editor/strings-views.ts`. Do not fix `strings-views.ts` — it belongs to someone else's branch. Task 2 adds the vendored `prototypes/paper-reference/` export to `.prettierignore` (it is a design-canvas dump, same class as the prettier-ignored `*.case.md` files). After that, `npm run lint` must be clean except for `strings-views.ts`.

## Cross-repo

`npm run bake:docs` writes into `../lifelines-core-loop/resources/cases/olsen/textures/`, and `npm run gen:content` writes `resources/cases/olsen/source/tiny_olsen_slice.json`. Both are this repo's own outputs — regenerating them IS the verification, not debt.

What core-loop still owes is filed as **GAP-002**: the engine has no payment path for a derived fact, its generated `tiny_olsen_case_pack.tres` needs regenerating, and five `tests/ui_driver/*.json` scripts drive the desk through the deleted `doc_konto`. Read GAP-002 before Task 5 — do not try to fix core-loop from here.

## Open tensions routed to Terje (Task 7 files them; nothing blocks on them)

1. **What pays `f_gap`.** The SDD retires its document and gives it a derived list. `case_engine.gd:lift_fact` pays facts from document runs, call lines, chat `pays_fact` and event deltas only — a derived fact hits none of them, and `# Recipe:` does not pay either. This repo emits `derived_from` and teaches the lint; the engine rule is GAP-002.
2. **When `f_husleie` becomes husleie.** The SDD's fact table anchors it on paper 1a (`KONTANTUTTAK SKRANKE`, arrives ~day 2), while the prose says the economy branch opens on day 6 after Bakkerud's letter names the rent. This plan follows the fact table, because the day-6 reading is SDD-067's lift-and-couple verb, which lives in core-loop and is out of scope here.

## SDD Deviations

1. **NAMING (not mechanism): the derived-fact field.** SDD-011 names the concept, not the markup field. This plan uses `Derived: f_trygd, f_husleie` on the `## f_gap` block, emitting `source_document_id: ''` plus `derived_from: ['f_trygd','f_husleie']`. Requires human decision: no.
2. **NAMING: Archivo file set.** SDD-011 asks for `Archivo-400.ttf` and `Archivo-700.ttf`. Upstream google/fonts ships only `Archivo[wdth,wght].ttf` (variable) — verified 2026-08-11. Ship the variable TTF and declare it across the weight range so 400 and 700 both render. Requires human decision: no.

## Slices

- **Slice 1 — independent content fix.** Task 1 (SB-091). Evidence: `npm run case:check` + re-bake.
- **Slice 2 — the table seam.** Tasks 2–3. Evidence: focused vitest with red-green, then a rendered PNG.
- **Slice 3 — the new paper.** Tasks 4–6. Evidence: `--stationery` renders, then `npm run bake:docs` + a manifest coverage assertion.
- **Slice 4 — hand off.** Task 7. Evidence: two gate tickets on the board.

## Standing rules

- Tests are your instrument, not the deliverable. Red-green every new test. The judge stanza on the task is the success criterion.
- Never resolve a design ambiguity by guessing. Route it to Terje as a gate ticket.
- Commit per task.
- Do not edit `.pm/data/**` by hand; use the `pm` CLI, run from this checkout.
designDecisions: SDD-011 grammar option A (Terje's pick): a `|` at line start inside a document body opens a table; consecutive `|` lines are one table; a blank line closes it. A separator row of `-` and `|` marks the row above as the header, and `---:` right-aligns that column.
Terje's ruling 2026-08-11: no stamps and no Frank marginalia. The papers stand bare and printed. Nothing a reader added by hand appears on them.
The coin goes in the column header once (`UT [icon=coin]`), never on every row.
The footer boilerplate and the address block stay authored paragraphs. Only the bank name and the strapline are template chrome.
`KONTOEN DISPONERES AV VERGE. KORT ER IKKE UTSTEDT.` is the load-bearing line in the set. It must print as flat boilerplate — it looks like nothing and proves he cannot buy anything.
`f_gap` keeps its id, loses its document, and gains `Derived: f_trygd, f_husleie`. It has 13 references across the case; deleting it would mean rewriting all of them.
`gate: f_gap` on `d_konto` becomes `gate: f_grete_baerer` — the doctor's line that she handles his errands is the reason to ask for the statement.

`prototypes/paper-reference/in-game-dokumenter.dc.html` is inspiration only (lab wireframe rule). Port the printed content and the letterhead structure; drop `transform: rotate()`, `box-shadow`, and every `sc-if` wear/stamp layer — the desk mesh maps the texture edge-to-edge and supplies its own light.
Editor chrome stays English; document content stays Norwegian.
A ragged table row warns as `DOC_TABLE_RAGGED` and never blocks the compile (project rule: stubs and drift warn).

tasks.title: Task 2: A pipe table in a document body compiles to a typed table block
tasks.description: Today every labContent document block is an untyped paragraph and the slice's `body_bbcode` is flat whitespace-collapsed prose. Pipe rows would collapse into garbage. Give blocks a `type`, add the table shape, and teach the BBCode form. Grammar is SDD-011 option A: a `|` at line start opens a table, consecutive `|` lines are one table, a blank line closes it, a separator row of `-` and `|` marks the row above as the header and `---:` right-aligns. Cells split on `|`, outer pipes are optional, cells are trimmed, `\|` escapes a literal pipe. A cell takes the same run grammar as prose — `[text](fact:id)` anchors and `[icon=coin]` work unchanged. Every cell is a run list, so UV measurement stays as it is. This task is compiler-side only; the renderers are Task 3. Note the parser needs no change — document prose lines are already captured verbatim (src/compiler/parse.ts:520); the block split happens in emit.ts where documentParagraphs is built (src/compiler/emit.ts:503-565, consumed at :1439-1458).

Run it and confirm it fails.

tasks.title: Task 6: The manifest proves every anchored fact measures on its sheet
tasks.description: The whole point of moving anchors into table cells is that the desk can highlight them. A fact whose span renders zero-width, or whose anchor silently failed to land in a cell, still appears in the manifest with an empty rect array — the bake would pass and the highlight would be invisible in the game. Close that hole at bake time. SDD-011 asks specifically that all five economy facts measure at least one UV rect on their new paper.
